title: Crispi Zucchini with Parmesan-Oregano Sauce
description: Thin zucchini half-moons braise in the Crispi and finish in a light Parmesan and oregano sauce.
equipment: Ninja Crispi PowerPod with US Bake preset

ingredients.name: fresh zucchini
ingredients.note: Peel if preferred; cut into 1/4-inch half-moons.

ingredients.name: low-sodium mushroom broth
ingredients.note: Use plain mushroom broth made with mushrooms and water.

steps.title: Set up the Crispi
steps.text: Use the room-temperature 6-cup Crispi glass container without an adapter. Leave out the crisper plate so the food sits in liquid. Load the container before starting the PowerPod and keep the storage lid off during cooking.

steps.title: Moisten the zucchini
steps.text: Fold {zucchini} through {broth}, {oregano} and {garlic} in the unheated glass. Press the half-moons down into the liquid in a shallow layer.

steps.title: Braise on Bake
steps.text: Seat the PowerPod and select Bake. Stir after 7 minutes, folding the top pieces into the broth. Continue for 4–9 minutes until the half-moons yield to a fork and still hold their shape.

steps.title: Save the cooking liquid
steps.text: Lift the zucchini into a covered serving bowl with a slotted spoon. Transfer the cooking liquid to the HexClad and bring to a simmer.

steps.title: Mix the slurry
steps.text: Stir {starch} into {water} in a small cup until smooth.

steps.title: Thicken the sauce
steps.text: Whisk the freshly stirred slurry into the simmering sauce and stir for 1 minute, until it coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Add cheese and zest
steps.text: Take the skillet off heat. Whisk {parmesan} and {zest} into the thickened liquid until smooth.

steps.title: Dress the zucchini
steps.text: Fold the sauce gently through the tender half-moons and serve warm.

notes: Make ahead: Slice the zucchini earlier the same day. Refrigerate it separately from the broth to keep the pieces intact. Option A uses lemon zest. For gentler Option B, omit it. For dairy-free sauce skip the Parmesan and finish with finely chopped fresh basil. Refrigerate promptly in shallow portions and use within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: No. Zucchini releases water after thawing and loses the tender shape that makes this side work. Fridge reheat: Warm a single portion with its sauce in a covered HexClad skillet over medium-low, adding a splash of water if thick. Stir or turn gently and begin checking after 5 minutes. Heat the zucchini to 165°F throughout. Freezer reheat: If already frozen, thaw overnight in the refrigerator and follow the fridge reheating directions. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 52 kcal, 3.0 g protein, 8.3 g total carbohydrate, 1.1 g fat, 1.5 g fiber, 65 mg sodium. Includes the measured broth and sauce. Sodium varies with your broth.
preferredMethod: Ninja Crispi PowerPod with US Bake preset

steps.title: Allow for oven timing
steps.text: Use the first time given as a check. A covered metal dish may need 3–10 minutes longer; check tenderness or the center temperature every 2–3 minutes.

steps.title: Heat the covered baking dish
steps.text: Preheat Samsung Bake to 350°F. Use a small metal baking dish and a fitted cover or foil to retain moisture.
